receipt.text: {orgName} has your request for {needLabel}. Your code is {routeCode}. We plan to help by {promiseAt}. Follow it here: {trackingLink}. In an emergency, call 911. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

consent_ask.text: {orgName} can ask {partnerName} to help with {needLabel}. May we share your first name, your ZIP code and your need with them? Answer here: {trackingLink}. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

partner_ask.text: {orgName} asks for help with {needLabel} in ZIP code {zip}. Please answer by {deadline}: {partnerLink}. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

partner_has_it.text: {partnerName} has your request {routeCode}. Your contact there is {contactName}. Follow it here: {trackingLink}. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

checkback.text: Did they help with {needLabel}? Answer 1 for yes, 2 for partly, 3 for no: {trackingLink}. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

unmet.text: We are sorry. We could not find help for {needLabel} yet. Your request stays open, and a person at ComForce keeps it. Follow it here: {trackingLink}. Your details are deleted 90 days after the request closes.

receipt.text: {orgName} recibió su solicitud de ayuda: {needLabel}. Su código es {routeCode}. Planeamos ayudarle a más tardar el {promiseAt}. Siga su solicitud aquí: {trackingLink}. En una emergencia, llame al 911. Sus datos se borran 90 días después de que se cierre la solicitud.

checkback.text: ¿Le ayudaron con {needLabel}? Responda 1 para sí, 2 para en parte o 3 para no: {trackingLink}. Sus datos se borran 90 días después de que se cierre la solicitud.
